AXIOMS: #print axioms for all 8 main declarations -> exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx.
Also appended a detailed entry to AUDIT_LEDGER.md ("## S1807 -- ...").

STATUS: 3 of S1769's 4 base-change conditions PROVED unconditionally for every field K.
  S1807.bcPreservesFiniteProducts : BCPreservesFiniteProducts K   -- PreservesFiniteProducts (bc K)
  S1807.bcPreservesEpis           : BCPreservesEpis K             -- PreservesEpimorphisms (bc K).op
  S1807.bcPreservesQuotients      : BCPreservesQuotients K        -- ∀ G [Group G] [Finite G], PreservesColimitsOfShape (SingleObj G) (bc K).op
plus the stronger theorem
  S1807.bc_preservesFiniteLimits   : PreservesFiniteLimits (bc K).
The four conditions are restated verbatim in namespace S1807 (same statements as S1769's
BCPreserves*), and S1807.bc K is definitionally S1769.bc K, so you can feed these three directly
as hCoprod / hEpi / hQuot to S1769.fiberFunctorOf; only hPull remains.

FIRST MISSING (unchanged and precise): BCPreservesPullbacks K =
PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (bc K).op = pushout preservation. It is NOT implied by
finite-limit preservation. The single missing mathematical input is the coherence
  Kbar ⊗[K] (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[Kbar] (Kbar ⊗[K] B) ⊗[Kbar ⊗[K] A] (Kbar ⊗[K] C)
compatible with the four canonical maps, for a span A --f--> B, A --g--> C of finite etale
K-algebras. I verified in Mathlib that no such lemma exists; the nearest tools are
Algebra.IsPushout.tensorProduct_tensorProduct (Mathlib/RingTheory/IsTensorProduct.lean:683),
IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg (line 832) and Algebra.IsPushout.comp_iff (line 756); a derivation
from these is the remaining formal work (I stopped before attempting it because the goal formula
also needs explicit Algebra (Kbar⊗A) (Kbar⊗B) instance binders, which makes it a multi-hour job
with real risk). Everything else needed is available: S1745's tensorCocone /
tensorCocone_isColimit (ambient CommAlgCat K) and isClosedUnderColimitsOfShape_walkingSpan, plus
walkingCospanOpEquiv : WalkingCospanᵒᵖ ≌ WalkingSpan.
Suggested next step for whoever takes it: state the coherence as an explicit AlgEquiv with
instance binders (`letI`), prove it via Algebra.pushoutDesc + Algebra.IsPushout.algHom_ext on
both sides, then transfer the pushout cocone with PushoutCocone.IsColimit.mk
(desc = pushoutDesc via Algebra.TensorProduct.liftEquivRight, fac = liftEquivRight naturality,
uniq = liftEquivRight injectivity + algHom_ext).

No fake: no sorry/admit/axiom, no weakened statement; the one condition I could not prove is
left as a definitional Prop (BCPreservesPullbacks) and is reported as missing rather than assumed
anywhere. Pitfalls I hit are recorded in the AUDIT_LEDGER entry (full-subcategory hom wrappers,
CommAlgCat.of vs stored instances, Algebra.TensorProduct.ext vs ext', Fintype from Finite).
